entry.title: Hıdırlık Tower
entry.note: Exact Q218118 mapped square podium way110321832. Native+Z points northeast toward the documented main entrance (the2005 survey and municipal account); native+X follows the facade northwest. The source outline measures about17.4m per side and agrees closely with the published17.20×17.30m podium. Upper round drum radius7.9m is established independently by the measured15.80m diameter in the Istanbul University thesis, rather than taking the ambiguous7.95m tourism value as a diameter. The encircling parapet’s higher infill is on the southwest/south/southeast side, following the published restoration description and municipal exterior photograph. Ground contact is the exposed podium plinth. The separately landscaped archaeological terrace, coastal cliff, excavated surrounding walls and contemporary glass decks remain host terrain/map features. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
